run_doom_human_mode: run the main function to play doom_health_gathering in human mode with 15 actions
create_doom_env: create a Doom environment using make_doom_env_impl with a custom resolution of 1280x720
build_doom_config: build a default configuration for the doom_health_gathering environment using default_cfg
review_doom_env_lookup: review the doom_env_by_name function to look up DoomSpec by environment name string
summarize_play_doom: summarize the play_doom module that launches a VizDoom environment in human-playable mode
